history.p: Gade worked on his Op. 58 for nearly three years making considerable changes before he was satisfied. It was not performed during his own lifetime. The first Danish performance took place in Musikforeningen on 26 February conducted by his brother-in-law Emil Hartmann.

physDesc.physMedium: 1 trimmed bifolio and 2 trimmed single folios. Written ink. Paper: 14 staves. Contains sketches in piano score for the new Andante and for the Finale end-dated: "Sept. 1883".

Written in ink and pencil. Various paginations. With numerous emendations and cancellations. Heading on p. 1: "1ste Manuscript til Novellette (N 2) / for Strygeinstrumenter / componeret 1883 i Es dur, / senere omarbeidet til E dur med ny Andante i C dur.".

titlePage.p: Novelletter / for / Strygeorchester / No 2 / E Dur / op. 58 / (1886) / Leipzig / Breitkopf & Härtel

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink. Paper: 16 staves. Verso of title page blank. Paginated 1-52 from first music page. Heading on p. 1: "Novelletter for Strygeinstrumenter -orchester (No. 2) Op. 58". With minor emendations. At the end of the music on p. 52 Gade has written: "Fine / Juli 1886 / (componeret / i Fredensborg, / Sommeren 18834. Es Dur / Omarbeidet i 1886. E-Dur) [Gade's musical signature] / 1886.".
